title: Soxhlet extraction of Momordica cochinchinensis fruit peel for β-carotene recovery
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6764-6773
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08999E, Paper
Open Access

Hai D. Tran, Nguyen Thi Tu Nguyen, Trinh Thu Phuong, Quoc Hai Nguyen, Van-Han Dang
The Soxhlet extraction of β-carotene from the fruit peel of Momordica cochinchinensis was modeled, yielding valuable insights into the kinetic parameters for operation and optimization.
